notes: You can now link courses you've already added to an application. On an application's card, press Link existing courses, tick the ones that belong to it, and they join in one go. Courses on another application are listed too, and move across.

When a course joins an application, steps the application already has (like your personal statement) are combined with it and stay ticked if you'd done them. Steps that are only about that course, like one university's open day, stay on that course's own checklist instead of being added to the shared one.
